title: Board spec, board/0
description: Views, and the part of the query they share. A board carries no layout: where each view stands is the surface's, as a view's size is its container's. It carries no state apart from itself either: its query is its params at their values now, so a surface that changes one holds a new board. boardViews() gives each view with the query to run, and boardSelect() the board after a view proposes a selection.

title.description: Shown by the surface, over the views.

query.description: What the views share, each a part of a query, laid under every view's own: a view that states its own range or compare keeps it. Metrics, by and limit are each view's.

where.description: The board's filter, and what is selected in it. A view is filtered by every dimension here but the ones it draws, which are those in its own by: on those it keeps every value and marks the ones held here. A view's own where is its own, and wins.

views.description: View specs, each whole and valid alone. Each needs a title, and no two the same: a board's views are told apart by their titles.
